CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the ApprovalStepConfig__mdt record for the currently active step. Cleared when the workflow reaches a terminal state (Approved, Rejected, Recalled).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maintained automatically. Matches the DeveloperName of the metadata record (e.g. GridAmendment_HOC), not a custom field value.
CustomField.label: Current Step Developer Name
